svg.title: Residents hold a clear market lane while Babul-da leads the ambulance through.
svg.desc: Shoppers and merchants keep their queue positions beneath the awnings while opening a central road. Babul-da walks backwards ahead of the ambulance, Riju lifts an awning rope, and Cecil tracks the clearance.
svg.text: Page 44, panel 4 · Long-lens view down the resident-made corridor

text.tspan: Local coordination moves the ambulance through
without cancelling anyone's place in the queue.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
